title: Derived OneDrive human visibility refresh
purpose: Provide one deterministic non-authoritative refresher for the existing OneDrive human course catalogue and a usable-kit catalogue, with signed-in OneDrive item links that never use /shared?.
invariants: GitHub remains authority for executable logic; OneDrive catalogue files remain derived non-authoritative views.
No product/runtime/Factory implementation or state is mutated.
A kit is shown usable only when exact kit bytes, HANDOFF_LOCATOR hash and PASS_AI_KIT_FACTORY_V1 evidence agree.
Generated human OneDrive links use /?id=<guid>&cid=<cid> and never /shared?.
requiredEvidence: Local fixture reconstructs two current courses and exactly one Factory-PASS kit DDHC_1789.
adversarialTests: Fail if any repository path outside the two allowed paths changes.
Fail if a generated human link contains /shared?.
Fail if a kit without exact matching PASS_AI_KIT_FACTORY_V1 evidence is presented as usable.
Fail if any product/runtime/Factory or authoritative OneDrive state is mutated.
independentReview: Verify the PR changes exactly tools/refresh_onedrive_catalogue.py and work-packages/GOV-WP-042.json.
Verify the refresher emits only derived views and does not write authoritative course or Factory state.
Verify OneDrive item links use /?id=<guid>&cid=<cid> and never /shared?.
Verify DDHC_1789 is included only when its exact kit hash and Factory PASS evidence match.
rollback: Revert tools/refresh_onedrive_catalogue.py and work-packages/GOV-WP-042.json. OneDrive derived views can be regenerated from prior logic or restored independently.
